messages:
Alice: Heads up — DeployBot blocked v2.14.0 release for service-auth. SBOM provenance mismatch detected.
DeployBot: [automated] SBOM provenance check FAILED for service-auth:sha256:abc123. Missing origin-signature. Severity: medium. Release blocked. CI report: https://ci.internal/reports/1768129999
Ben: Which registry/region did this happen in?
DeployBot: Affected artifacts: service-auth:sha256:abc123 (linux/amd64). No flag for arm. Regions: us-west-2, eu-west-1 canaries.
Carla: I saw the same in staging earlier — only the linux build. Could be signing step skipped in the linux runner.
Devon: Is this a missing cosign signature or mismatched SBOM digest?
DeployBot: SBOM lists source for libcrypto as 'unknown' vs expected 'vendor:openssl@1.1.1'. Manifest lacks 'signedManifest' entry.
Priya: LegalReviewBot, what's the compliance ask here?
LegalReviewBot: Automated request: provide signed-manifest, build-id, KMS key-id used for signing. If not provided, enterprises with audit requirements must be rolled back.
Ben: Can we attach a signature after the fact with cosign attach? That would avoid rebuild in theory.
Carla: Maybe. But our build process didn't record the signing material; cosign attach needs the signature and access to the same layers. If we can produce signature via KMS and attach, digest stays the same.
Devon: Timebox? Change window is 14:00–16:00 PST today. We have ~45m.
Alice: Decision options: 1) Rollback to v2.13.9 for all regions now, unblock customers. 2) Temporary pin/exception and attach signature (if possible) during change window. Legal prefers rollback unless we can provide signed-manifest within 1 hour.
Priya: Legal's recommendation: rollback unless we can demonstrate chain-of-custody quickly.
Ben: Ops: I can try cosign attach flow. Need KMS key access and a signature producer. If I can get key access now, I can attempt attach within ~20–30m.
Carla: @Ben, check runner logs — linux runner might have skipped cosign step due to intermittent keyservice auth failures. If you can re-run signing against the existing image digest, attach should succeed.
Ben: Command I'll attempt:
```
# generate detached signature using KMS
cosign sign --key k8s://projects/prod/kms/service-signing-key \  
  --output-signature sig1.out docker://registry/service-auth@sha256:abc123
# attach signature without changing digest
cosign attach --type signature --signature sig1.out docker://registry/service-auth@sha256:abc123
```
Devon: If that works, we can lift the deploy hold. Still need Legal to ack.
Alice: Plan: Ben attempts cosign attach now. If success -> LegalReviewBot to verify artifacts; if verified before 15:00 PST we proceed with release. If fail -> rollback initiated at 15:00 PST. Everyone OK?
Ben: Starting the attach attempt now. Will post logs.
DeployBot: [automated] Rollout paused: v2.14.0 -> canary queues suspended by SBOM-gate.
Ben: cosign attach progress: trying KMS auth... got permission denied on first attempt, retrying with service-account override.
Carla: I'm handing over KMS escalations to @Devon — Devon, can you grant Ben access?
Devon: Granting temporary kms.signer role to ben-svc-account for 1 hour.
Ben: Auth succeeded. Running sign + attach...
Ben: attach completed, signature uploaded.
Ben: Verification step: `cosign verify --signature sig1.out docker://registry/service-auth@sha256:abc123` -> OK.
Ben: Pushed SBOM updated metadata via registry API to include signed-manifest reference. Registry responded 200.
LegalReviewBot: Received artifacts. Running automated compliance checks...
LegalReviewBot: Compliance Status: PENDING_MANUAL_REVIEW (requires one human approval for provenance edges).
Priya: I'll do the quick manual check — looking at build-id and key-id... build-id matches CI/2026-03-20/2271, key-id = projects/prod/kms/service-signing-key, timestamp within CI window.
Priya: Looks good to me. Manual approval granted.
LegalReviewBot: Manual approval recorded by Priya at 1768130400. Compliance gate cleared.
DeployBot: [automated] SBOM gate cleared. Resuming canary rollout to eu-west-1.
Alice: Nice work. Action items:
- Ben: add a pipeline guard to retry cosign on transient KMS errors (ticket #RI-5321)
- Carla: add staging test to detect missing signed-manifest earlier (ticket #RI-5322)
- Devon: document temporary KMS grant playbook for on-call (ticket #OPS-214)
Ben: I'll update release notes: short blurb about temporary hold and verification.
Ben: Release notes draft:
"v2.14.0 — Deployment resumed after SBOM provenance verification. A transient signing step failure caused a temporary hold; image signature was attached and verified. No user-facing behavior changed."
Carla: Also add postmortem stub in release doc and tag for follow-up.
Priya: Legal will close the compliance loop and add note to customer audit doc.
Devon: Closing the canary watch after 30m. If no regressions, proceed to full rollout.
Alice: Thanks team. Marking thread resolved once full rollout completes. :white_check_mark:
